issues.description: The problem statement and template require the computed pixel memory address to be produced in ESI and the initial pixel value loaded with 'mov ecx, [esi]'. The provided solution, however, computes/reads the value using EDI (mov ecx, [edi]) and leaves ESI set to display_start instead of the pixel address. This mismatch (ESI vs EDI) means the solution does not follow the register convention described in the task and will cause the printed initial value and subsequent uses of the saved pointer to be incorrect.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the solution so the computed byte address of the pixel is placed in ESI and load the initial pixel value with 'mov ecx, [esi]'. Concretely: compute offset = y * (1920*4) + x * 4, then compute ESI = display_start + offset, then 'mov ecx, [esi]'. Ensure any temporaries are preserved/restored so the final ESI contains the pixel address as required by the template/problem.
